index.title: mbedded-cbor
index.brief: A header-only C++ library for CBOR (RFC 8949).
index.install:
cmake -S mbedded-cbor -B build -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF
cmake --install build --prefix /usr/local

find_package(mbedded-cbor 0.9 CONFIG REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE mbedded-cbor::mbedded-cbor)
index.compilers: Builds with g++ 15 or later, clang 21 or later, AppleClang of Xcode 26 and clang-cl of Visual Studio, in C++23 or C++26. cl.exe (MSVC) is not supported: it cannot evaluate the compile-time code of cbor::schema, cbor::structs and cbor::at_path.

console.title: Console
console.lead: Type calls on doc, the message below, or on bytes, its bytes. doc is a cbor::result<cbor::lazy>, so -> reads the lazy, as in C++. Each call runs in the library, compiled to WebAssembly. It is not a C++ compiler: a loop or a new struct does not run here.

samples.title: Read a field by its path
samples.text: at_path goes to the value of a JSONPath and reads it as the type. A text comes back as a view into the message.

samples.title: Read an element by its index
samples.text: An index in the path goes to that element of an array.

samples.title: Read the value of one key
samples.text: at goes to the value of one key and reads nothing else of the message.

samples.title: Read all values of a path
samples.text: With cbor::nodelist, a path with [*] gives every value that matches.

samples.title: Show the message as text
samples.text: diagnostic_notation writes the bytes as CBOR diagnostic notation.

samples.title: Read a value with the wrong type
samples.text: A value of another type comes back as a cbor::error, not as an exception.

console.reads: A call on doc or on bytes: doc->at("user"). -> on a cbor::result, . on a value. get<T>() with a type: int, double, std::string_view. at_path<"...">() with a JSONPath of RFC 9535. cbor::key{1} for a key that is a number. The Tab key or the button shows the names that fit.
console.brief: type calls on a CBOR message and see the results
